title: Epistemophilia
author: Mehmetcan Serinkaya
description:
How Far Are You Willing to Go?

With a blank mind, you wake up in a strange place. What you'll do next, will shape an entire journey. It will be dangerous, even nerve-racking at times. Will you survive the ride? How far are you willing to go in the search for knowledge?

In Epistemophilia, choices matter. The story can last ten minutes or several hours and it can end in twenty four different ways. Ultimately, it will be the player's choice to settle on a truth.
